target: explicit approximate Standard Modern Greek graphemes; not Greek translation
alignment: all ordered nonoverlapping 10/11-glyph windows in97; zero-based u=0..76, v=u+10..86
normalization: NFC uppercase Greek; no stress, vowel length, word spaces or separators in tested stream
inverse_limit: outer Greek-character cipher injective on valid Greek strings; phonetic conversion is lossy, English spelling not recovered
